title: Binding Support Management Services; Stage 3 (BSF SBI)
tagline: BSF — find the right PCF for UE, slice, and DNN
summary: TS 29.521 defines the Nbsf_Management service. In roaming and multi-PCF deployments, SMF may need the PCF instance bound to a UE/S-NSSAI/DNN before CreateSMPolicy. BSF stores and returns PCF bindings; a 308 redirect on CreateSMPolicy may also point to the bound PCF per 29.512 entry points.
defines: Nbsf_Management — PCF binding registration and discovery
CreatePCFBinding — register PCF for UE context
PCF binding info for slice/DNN/roaming scenarios
whyItMatters: NRF discovers any PCF offering Npcf_SMPolicyControl, but BSF resolves which PCF is bound to this UE and session. Without BSF in the story, multi-PCF and roaming policy paths are incomplete.

entryPoints.description: Discover PCF binding before or after NRF discovery.

entryPoints.description: Alternative path when BSF binding not required.
